lines.en: I show up at the convenience store to find it completely empty.
I steal everything and go home.
Just kidding.
I do stand there for a mildly concerning amount of time, though.
Leaving the counter in a place like this unattended isn’t exactly a good move, especially considering I could reach over and open the register whenever I want.
Granted, there are probably cameras installed and I can’t imagine it would be particularly hard to identify someone who looks like me.
So I guess I’ll just keep waiting until Noriko shows up.
: Okay, I’m done with this.
I turn around to leave and-
: Psst!
: Hi.
: Did you really just let me stand at the counter that entire time without saying anything?
: I was just admiring that you’re equally as cute from behind as you are from the front.
: Also, I thought you’d be smart enough to maybe look behind you once or twice before giving up and going home.
: Always look forward, Noriko. Let this be your lesson for the day.
: What if somebody taps on my shoulder or something?
: Just keep on walking.
: This sounds like bad advice.
: It's a lot more motivational without any follow-ups.
: So...did you actually come here of your own volition today? Or did you just happen to wander in coincidentally again?
: My appearance is very much intentional. I’m here to hang out with you.
: Are you on break or something?
: I’m pretty much always on break.
: People don’t like to walk around this neighborhood at night, so we’re dead for most of the hours that I'm here.
: You should see the place at like 3:00 AM. Total ghost town. Or...ghost store, I guess.
: You don’t actually work that late do you?
: Not all the time, but I have in the past. Normally during summer or winter break, though. Just for extra money and stuff.
: I applaud your work ethic. I can barely handle the hours I put in at[school].
: I’m sure it’s really taxing for you to just show up and do nothing every day, huh?
: You have no idea.
: Well, hey. If you ever need any help around the class or anything, I’d be more than willing to lend a hand.
: I’m sure you’ve got loads of clerical stuff piling up by now, right?
: Oh, not really. The class rep normally handles all of that for me.
: Is she in love with you too?
: Maybe?
: Well that’s just fucking great.
: Or maybe not. I don’t know. Please don’t kill her.
: I’m not going to kill her. It’s just...
: More and more people keep getting in between us and I kind of want them to at least let me catch up first.
: Like, I’m way behind in everything except for stuff that you can’t even remember yet.
: On the bright side, I’m giving you plenty of time to catch up with how much I’m starting to visit your workplace.
: Yeah...But do you think that maybe you’d visit me more if I worked a little closer to the dorms?
: Oh! How do you think I would look as a maid?!
: Ami and that really short girl with the surprisingly large chest work there, right?!
: That seems easy enough. And a lot more exciting than sitting around eating prepackaged vegan sushi all night.
: I’m actually not sure how you’d look in a maid uniform.
: Because I’m not girly enough?
: Yes. And no.
: I’ve just never seen you in anything girlier than your pajamas, so it’s hard for me to envision it.
: I can be girly!
: Let me come over and try on Ami’s uniform. She’ll let me.
: Are you sure about that?
: If she doesn’t, you can hold her down and I can run into her room and raid her closet.
: I thought you didn’t like dressing like that? Because of...your expression or whatever it was.
: Well it would obviously be different if it was for a job.
: Maids are just personas those girls put on to trick gullible men like you into giving them all of your money.
: I can assure you that I am fully aware of how greatly I am taken advantage of inside that place. Gullibility has nothing to do with it.
: The last thing I need is one more girl who’s able to peer into my soul that effectively.
: Are you sure about that, Sensei?
: I’ve told you before that I bring both the childhood friend trope and the little sister trope to the table.
: Unless...Onii-chan just doesn’t want to see his sister in a dress because he’ll realize how quickly she’s growing up...
: I’m not the same girl I used to be, Onii-chan. I have...feelings.
: I have...needs.
I look down to find that I am already reaching into my wallet for spare change.
Damn all of these girls.
: As good as I think you’d be at the maid cafe, I don’t see a need for you to relocate just for me.
: Noriko?
: Don’t you want to fulfill my needs, Onii-chan?...
: Pfft!
: I can’t keep a straight face anymore, I’m sorry.
: You are...actually a pretty good actor.
: Oh, stop. A good actor wouldn’t break out in laughter after delivering a line like that.
: Also...it’s not really acting.
: I obviously think of you when...yeah.
: But it is kind of embarrassing saying it out loud.
: I feel like you’ve said much worse and gotten much less embarrassed.
: The mood someone is in when they say something greatly impacts the way in which it’s delivered, Onii-chan.
: If I’m turned on while I talk to you about being turned-on, I’ll probably be a lot more reserved than I would be if I was feeling totally normal.
: Are you...actually turned on right now?
: I think this “Onii-chan” thing might be a kink for me.
: The more I think about it...the more I...
: Earth to Noriko.
: Yes! Noriko! Me! Hi!
: What’s up?
: Just trying to figure out how I should handle the horny version of you.
: Why would you word it like that?! That’s just going to make it worse!
: Also, I...
: You what?
: Job!
: What kind of job?
: Mouth!
: Please don’t call it a “mouthjob.”
: I mean work job! Future! Plans! Help!
: I want you to help me think about stuff that doesn’t cause my innocent heart to crave less than innocent things.
: Especially while the rice balls are watching.
: Are we really back to that?
: They are like children to me.
: Tiny, delicious Nakayarakawayamas.
: I will destroy anyone who comes close to them.
: That will likely be bad for business.
: Let’s just...talk more about other stuff I can do. Okay?
: Like, I obviously can’t work at a convenience store forever. And if you choose someone else over me, I’ll need something solid to fall back on.
: Preferably something where I’ll still have enough free time to dedicate to making you realize you made the wrong choice.
: You’re not going to give up on me even if I wind up with someone else?
: I am in...way too deep to ever do something like that.
: Nee-chan, too, probably.
: I guess our whole family is just naturally weak to you for some reason, Onii-chan.
: Oh no! The horny! It’s back!
: There’s no way your whole family is weak to me. Like, what about your parents?
: Thanks. The horny is gone again.
: I thought about you and my dad and that just...
: Yeah, that’s just not doing it for me.
: I would have much preferred if you had used your mother in that fantasy.
: But that could like...actually happen.
: She loved you just as much as Nee-chan and I did. I don’t think it’s crazy to believe someone her age looked at [teenage]Sensei and thought “You know what? I’m down.”
: My dad, though...
: Please stop bringing up your dad.
: Oh my God! What if we actually started dating and you wanted to marry me, so like...
: You went to my father to ask him for permission and he was just like...
: You can have my daughter...but only after I test your abilities as a man...
: And then he’d ask you to take your pants off and-
: Wow, would you look at the time? I think I have to get going.
: Wait, no! I promise I’ll stop fantasizing about you and my dad!
: Oh, hi! I’ll be with you in just a sec!
: Okay! See you later!
: She left.
: She did.
: You should probably be careful about what you yell inside of a convenience store.
: Eh. It’s late. She knew what she was getting herself into when she walked in.
: And now she’s probably adding her dad to some sort of weird sexual fantasy and is going to blame us for it.
: Look what we’ve done, Onii-
: Sensei.
: I didn’t stop myself in time.
: The horny returns.
: I’m going to have to remember this for when it comes time to choose your lust name.
: What’s a lust name? It sounds fun.
: It’s just a thing. I wouldn’t worry about it until later.
: Do I get to choose one too?
: No. You stay out of this.
: Mmm!
: You do that pouting thing a lot, don’t you?
: It helps me get what I want!
: Or at least it probably would if I didn’t have these “crazy eyes” people keep talking about!
: The failure rate of my pouting suddenly makes a lot more sense!
: Then...stop?
: It’s muscle memory at this point! I can’t!
: Oh! I totally forgot to ask you something!
: What’s up?
: Is it true that you’re sexually attracted to those cartoon ponies from that one TV show?
: Did Kirin tell you this?
: It just slipped out, I think.
: How does something like that just slip out?
: I don’t know, but I need to know.
: If you need to know...then, yes.
: I am a proud brony. Tried and true.
: Do you have a favorite? I like the one with the hair that’s all like “whoooosh,” you know?
: Ahh, yes. Rainbow Dash.
: Yeah, her! Is she your favorite too?
: My favorite pony is whichever one is on screen at the time.
: I didn’t realize you were into them, too, Noriko.
: Well...I definitely don’t get the urge to fuck them. But they’re totally cute.
: Oh, and have you seen the human versions? They’re like, just as good.
: Oh. You’re one of those...
: ...One of what?
: Don’t worry about it.
: Have you ever played Raid: Shadow Legends before?
Hi guys, it’s me! Selebus!
I just wanted to take a second to tell you about-
Sike.
I had you going for a second though, didn’t I?
: Remember how I was talking about that one super smart girl who beat me in the standardized tests?
: Is there any chance she could move to our class, too?
: She was talking to me about it and apparently she’s already friends with that girl Futaba who sits by the window.
Smart girl...friends with Futaba...
: Is her name Nodoka?
: Yeah!
: She said that you two met before, but she wasn’t sure if you’d remember her or not.
: I have a hard time forgetting girls who talk about seeing other girls naked. I remember her.
: I see Kirin naked all the time now. She’s hot.
: See? Like, I’m going to remember that for the rest of forever.
: Boy brains are funny.
: They’re not funny. They’re just simple.
: Leave us alone.
: Never~
: Anyway, I should probably start heading back.
: I really only came over here to see how you were doing.
: You didn’t need to do that...I know it’s a crazy far walk.
: I’m sure Kirin wouldn’t mind if you came over to the dorm to hang out really late, so just do that instead from now on and save yourself some steps.
: I don’t know if I like the idea of staying up that late just to come hang out in the dorm.
: Okaaaaay~ But you’ll be missing a chance to cuddle with pajama Noriko.
: Or pajama Kirin, I guess. But I’m less enthusiastic about you coming over at night to choose her over me.
: How about I just...keep doing what I normally do and hope it doesn’t become too annoying?
: That’s fine, too, I guess.
: I’ll just go to sleep all alone, without my Onii-chan there to-
: Ahh~
: Why aren’t you stopping me from calling you that?
: Why would I ever stop something as awesome as this? Do it again.
: Onii...
: Mm~
I stay just long enough to watch Noriko squirm in her seat a few more times before deciding to buy a drink and heading back home.
She texts me for the next ten minutes or so as I make my way through the dark streets of the second half of town.
I’m pretty sure she just wants to keep tabs on me so I don’t get mugged or something like that.
She’s a good girl.
Probably.
She still worries me from time to time.
But at least her heart is in the right place-
Tightly wrapped around my fingers.
Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!
